test.//: Default (in-process) lane. The live JVM/Python conformance matrix moved to gate.e2e.ts under the on-demand `e2e` target (which owns `apigen-java:package` + `apigen-python-env:build`), so this lane no longer needs a JVM. Override of the inferred `test` target carries only `dependsOn` (`lint`/`^build`) plus `inputs` excluding `*.e2e.ts`; executor/cache/outputs come from inference.
test.//inputs: Exclude *.e2e.ts so editing a resource-consuming suite never invalidates the default lane's cache — it never runs those files (its vitest `include` is `src/**/*.spec.ts`, see vite.config.ts). Mirrors the workspace targetDefaults.test inputs plus the negative pattern.

e2e.//: RESOURCE-CONSUMING lane. Deliberately NOT part of `affected` and NOT referenced by any target's dependsOn or by targetDefaults — it runs ONLY on an explicit `nx run apigen-engine-conformance:e2e` (nx affected never selects it). It runs the sibling *.e2e.ts suite via vitest.e2e.config.ts. `dependsOn` is the resource prerequisites those tests need: `conformance` (the SINGLE live-matrix execution path — its durable report is what gate.e2e.ts asserts against, so the live TS+Python+Java matrix is never duplicated), plus `apigen-java:package` and `apigen-python-env:build` (the JVM/Python host prerequisites the lane's own runJavaMatrix negative-control and the matrix need).
